assay: bulk polyA RNA-seq of whole mouse heart (Illumina HiSeq2500, Novogene)
design: 2x2 factorial: genotype (WT vs cardiomyocyte-specific PGC-1a KO) x exercise (sedentary vs 6-week voluntary wheel running), n=5 male mice per group (Fig 2e/f, Fig 4a legends)
primary_estimand: Effect of 6-week voluntary wheel endurance training on the heart transcriptome within each genotype (WT_Ex vs WT_Sed; KO_Ex vs KO_Sed), Fig 2e-f
planned_contrasts: WT_Ex vs WT_Sed (Fig 2e GSEA Hallmark OXPHOS NES=5.14 FDR=8.8e-5; Fig 2f; no DEG count reported)
KO_Ex vs KO_Sed (Fig 2e GSEA OXPHOS NES=-10.22 FDR=8.2e-5; no DEG count reported)
KO_Sed vs WT_Sed (Fig 4a volcano, Gdf15 most upregulated; no DEG count reported)
KO_Ex vs WT_Ex (Fig 4a volcano, Gdf15 most upregulated; no DEG count reported)
repeated_measure_unit: none; each mouse contributes one heart
paper_method: DESeq2 (S4.10.p1); GSEA classic mode on Hallmark MH and M8 gene sets
paper_results: No DEG counts given in text or figure legends; GSEA OXPHOS up in WT training, depleted in KO training (FIG11 e); Gdf15 top upregulated KO vs WT in both states (S2.4.p2, FIG13 a)
